## Ollantaytambo excursions: Inca terraces and journeys through the Sacred Valley

Ollantaytambo lies in Peru's Cusco region, in the Urubamba River valley. Massive stone terraces, stairways and remains of Inca-period structures rise above the historic settlement. Elements of the old street plan and water channels survive in the town. For travelers, it is a chance to discover how an Inca town was organized while surrounded by mountains.

When selecting an excursion, distinguish **a visit to the Ollantaytambo archaeological complex** from **departure from Ollantaytambo railway station**. Both appear in our programs, but only the first entails exploring the local ruins.

## Which Ada Tours excursions visit Ollantaytambo?

We offer several itineraries with different content:

- The [Sacred Valley of the Incas excursion](/peru/cusco/sacred-valley-of-the-incas-tour/) combines Urubamba, Pisac, Ollantaytambo, Chinchero and other sites in the valley. This is a good first introduction to local archaeology.
- The [Sacred Valley: Pisac, Awanakancha and Ollantaytambo excursion](/peru/cusco/sacred-valley-pisac-awanakancha-ollantaytambo/) is a full-day program. It includes the Pisac craft market, animals at Awanakancha, the Ollantaytambo archaeological complex and lunch.
- The [Pisac, Ollantaytambo and Wayra Lunch Show excursion](/peru/sacred-valley-of-the-incas/pisac-ollantaytambo-wayra-lunch/) combines Sacred Valley monuments with a traditional performance during lunch.
- The [Machu Picchu aboard the Hiram Bingham excursion](/peru/machu-picchu/machu-picchu-hiram-bingham-sanctuary-tea/) uses Ollantaytambo railway station. Its main attraction is Machu Picchu; a separate visit to the Ollantaytambo archaeological park is not confirmed as part of that journey.

The town's name appearing in an itinerary therefore does not automatically mean a guided visit to its fortress and terraces.

## What can you see on a visit?

The archaeological complex is notable for its stepped agricultural terraces, enormous fitted stone blocks, passages and hillside structures. A guide can explain how the terrain influenced defense, farming, ceremonies and the distribution of urban space.

The settlement itself is no less important. Its old streets and water channels connect the archaeological site's history with the life of the town. More about its architecture and geography appears on the [Ollantaytambo place page](/peru/place/ollantaytambo/), while this collection helps you choose a visiting program.

According to the Cusco culture authority, the archaeological park stands at approximately **2,860 m** above sea level. A shorter, more level route with a ramp at the entrance is available and takes roughly 35 minutes. Confirm which sections are accessible to visitors with limited mobility and the precise visiting conditions for your travel date.

## How to allocate time among the stops

The Sacred Valley contains several attractions offering different experiences. Pisac is known for archaeology and crafts; Urubamba for valley scenery; Ollantaytambo for its terraces and historic layout. A route through Awanakancha also introduces llamas, alpacas and local handicrafts.

| Program | Main highlights |
|---|---|
| Sacred Valley of the Incas | Several historic sites |
| Pisac – Awanakancha – Ollantaytambo | Crafts, archaeology and lunch |
| Pisac – Ollantaytambo – Wayra | Monuments and a cultural show |
| Hiram Bingham | Rail journey to Machu Picchu |

The programs differ in services, language of guiding and other conditions. Lunch included on one itinerary should not be assumed to be included on another simply because both pass through Ollantaytambo.

## Altitude, roads and admission tickets

Walking on stone steps calls for stable shoes, water and sun protection. If you have recently arrived in the Andes, keep a moderate pace even when the excursion is not technically a trek. Temperatures can drop after sunset at altitude, so bring an extra layer.

Conservation rules apply within the archaeological area. Visitors must not walk on walls or historic structures outside permitted passages. Entry times and ticket types depend on current regulations and should be confirmed before the excursion.

If you are also traveling to [Machu Picchu](/peru/place/machu-picchu/) on the same day, check the connection with the train's departure time separately. Getting to the station and visiting the archaeological complex take different amounts of time.

## How to choose the right program

If you are interested in ancient Inca cities, choose an excursion that explicitly includes **Ollantaytambo and a visit to the archaeological complex**. If you want to combine culture with food, consider the Wayra option. If the main priority is reaching Machu Picchu, compare rail itineraries instead.

The full range of options is available in the [Peru excursions catalog](/peru/excursion/) and [Peru tours catalog](/peru/tour/). Historic itineraries are also collected in the [Culture and History section](/interests/culture-and-history/).

## Frequently asked questions about Ollantaytambo excursions

### Do all excursions mentioning Ollantaytambo include a fortress visit?

No. Several Sacred Valley programs visit the archaeological complex, while on the Hiram Bingham journey Ollantaytambo is listed as a railway station.

### Must visitors climb to the upper terraces?

No. An officially designated shorter route offers more level access. Its suitability and availability should be checked against each traveler's needs.

### Can you visit Pisac and Ollantaytambo on the same day?

Yes. Our Sacred Valley excursions link both places. Check the chosen program for its precise list of additional stops.
